title: ID0421739 -DC/Si-D/FI-[MP / P6 170000741]-Duplicated OCPP StartTransaction for one session
description:
Reported behavior/issue:
When session is starting, charger sends 2 x StartTransaction to OCPP server and thus OCPP server will create 2 different “TransacionID” for same session.
AWS query, screenshot and customer evidence from OCPP server (excel) can be find from timeline. Please check AWS 2-3 days backward.
Remark:
Customer evidence → charger sent multiple time “PowerLoss” messages?
Duplicated
secc events: {"type":"SeccStartCharging","outletId":}
Solution:
Child case has been created-0421900

additional_info.subject: AWS query
additional_info.body:
fields
@timestamp
,
@message
,
@logStream
|
filter
@message
like
/OCPP/
and
@message
like
/Transaction/
|
filter
@logStream
like
/YX5xq0/
|
parse
@message
'OCPP:*:'
as
direction
|
parse
@message
'command:*('
as
reason
|
parse
@message
'"connectorId":*,'
as
socket
|
parse
@message
'"idTag":"*",'
as
tag
|
filter
direction
like
/Send command/
|
sort
by
@timestamp
desc
|
limit
10000
